previous_working_selection.basis: The child Jhone baptised at Mid Calder on 26 June 1608 would have been about 40–41 when Johne was named as father in neighbouring Kirknewton/East Calder on 22 April 1649. The shared forename, adjacent locality and compatible generation favour retaining John Glasgow-3296 as the selected uncertain father at 28%. The child-to-adult identity and the older Mid Calder-to-Quothquan identity remain separate uncertainties; no shared holding, trade, spouse, witness or proved sibling supplies a discriminating bridge. The 1609 William baptism provides local context, not independent proof of the 1649 adult identity.

probability.basis: The child Jhone baptised at Mid Calder on 26 June 1608 would have been about 40–41 when Johne was named as father in neighbouring Kirknewton/East Calder on 22 April 1649. The shared forename, adjacent locality and compatible generation favour retaining John Glasgow-3296 as the selected uncertain father at 28%. The child-to-adult identity and the older Mid Calder-to-Quothquan identity remain separate uncertainties; no shared holding, trade, spouse, witness or proved sibling supplies a discriminating bridge. The 1609 William baptism provides local context, not independent proof of the 1649 adult identity. John-1086 primarily represents the 1685 Quothquan decedent, only possibly the 1608 child; John-3296 primarily represents the 1650 Quothquan decedent, only possibly the Mid Calder father. The 1650 omission of children is not an exclusion. John-1084, the 1616 child of James-991, is a substantive compatible adult-identity alternative through its 1642 Porteous marriage, 1643 Edinburgh child and tree-only 1652 Kirknewton/East Calder child. Keep James-991 an unselected father alternative conditional on that identity, without percentage, merger or maternity assignment. Robert-4006 remains a father-generation alternative; John-3056 a compatible childhood comparison. William-1087 remains an unsupported removed father, not biologically excluded merely by his 1609 baptism. Margaret-3112 has disputed 1646/1649 readings; Alexander-3118 has an estimated circa-1650 birth from a 1667 marriage, not a baptism. Use the secure 1649 occurrence, not a proved 1646–1650 series.
